heading: Establishment of Task Force
lead: There is hereby established a task force on prohibition of importation of products of forced or prison labor from the People’s Republic of China (hereafter in this part referred to as the “Task Force”).

ancestors.heading: TRADE AND RULE OF LAW ISSUES IN THE PEOPLE’S REPUBLIC OF CHINA
Task Force on Prohibition of Importation of Products of Forced or Prison Labor From the People’s Republic of China
